relationship: A single linear scale factor changes corresponding lengths by that factor, areas by its square and volumes by its cube.

learnerLoop.action: Resize the production solid, compare observations and complete the scale-factor chain.
learnerLoop.modelChange: All solid edges, layers, area and volume values update from one scale factor.
learnerLoop.evidence: The linked solids, unit layers, recorded trials and calculation chain show the powers of scale.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Use the observed linear factor to predict or explain the area and volume factor.

invariants: Similar solids keep one common linear scale factor across corresponding edges.
Area and volume factors are respectively the square and cube of that factor.
safeAdaptations: Vary positive scale factors and prototype dimensions.
Adjust working support while preserving the linked length, area and volume representations.
nonGoals: Applying the linear scale factor directly to area or volume.

task.description: Current scale problem, target and working prompt.
task.visibility: Shown for the current generated trial.

model.description: Prototype, scaled solid, unit layers and annotations update as the scale handle changes.
model.visibility: Present throughout; result/layer controls follow the solved state.

working.description: Scale-factor, area and volume prediction/calculation entries for the selected working level.
working.visibility: Always present; generated prediction buttons and answer fields depend on phase and level.

evidence.description: Linked edge/face/volume annotations, recorded trials and similarity relationship show linear, square and cube factors.
evidence.visibility: Evidence updates during resizing and after a successful trial.

completion.description: Solved scale trial, next trial and optional counterexample action.
completion.visibility: Completion actions appear after target and working/prediction checks pass.

settings.description: Working support, reset, layer view and counterexample restore controls.
settings.visibility: Some/All and counterexample/layer controls unlock from source progression.

inputs.description: Generated scale/height handle and prediction/calculation inputs.
inputs.visibility: Handle is present for the active geometry; generated entries follow the current trial.

linear-scale.description: Common edge scale from prototype edge 2 to the production edge/height.
linear-scale.domain: Positive scale factor k and corresponding edge length.
linear-scale.output: Solid dimensions, edge annotation and k in #evidenceStack/#workChain.

area-factor.description: Corresponding face-area factor k², with prototype/production face values.
area-factor.domain: Area units and square scale factor.
area-factor.source: Computed from the common linear scale; predicted by data-predict=area at the initial stage.

volume-factor.description: Solid-volume factor k³ and corresponding volume values.
volume-factor.domain: Cubic units and cube scale factor.
volume-factor.source: Computed from production/prototype dimensions; predicted by data-predict=volume.

counterexample.description: A stretch in one dimension used to show unequal ratios and loss of similarity.
counterexample.domain: Dimension ratio and non-similar solid measures.
counterexample.source: Generated stretch counterexample after the source threshold.

modes.none: Source level 0 is labelled Shown: the edge is manipulated and the relationship evidence is displayed; prediction choices may be required before resizing.
modes.some: Source level 1 is labelled Some: the learner supplies the linear scale factor k.
modes.all: Source level 2 is labelled All: the learner supplies k plus generated area/volume/factor fields.
modes.trial-types: The source also generates direct edge trials and reverse area/volume trials at All; a stretch counterexample and separate-layer view appear only from solved progression.

dependencies: At level 0, required area/volume prediction choices precede resize when the trial asks for them; targetMet requires the target edge or the counterexample's restore height.
Completion requires targetMet, requiredCorrect, predictionCorrect and no active stretch counterexample; geometry changes invalidate prior working checks.
Working fields are generated in #workChain and recordCurrent captures successful observations; Some/All unlock from solved counts.
The stretch counterexample is opened only after the source's level-2 solve threshold and must be restored before the local trial can complete.
implementation.completion: The source problemComplete check opens the solved result in #relationshipDock/#workActions when target, working and prediction conditions pass; next trial and level upgrade actions are then available.
limitations: The scale handle and prediction buttons are generated for the current trial; prediction controls are identified by data-predict rather than fixed IDs.
Separate-layer mode is a visual representation action and does not add an answer quantity.
